title: Taylor Swift could appear at Chiefs vs. Raiders game in Las Vegas
seoTitle: Taylor Swift at Chiefs vs. Raiders in Vegas?
subtitle: Fans expect the singer's presence at the showdown between Kansas City and Las Vegas this Sunday afternoon
excerpt: The match between the Chiefs and Raiders, set for today at 4:25 PM (Brasília time), has sparked speculation about the possible presence of Taylor Swift.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Just Jared, Billboard, The Big Lead
trending: is taylor swift at the chiefs game today
contentHtml:
The game between the Kansas City Chiefs and Las Vegas Raiders, played this Sunday afternoon, has taken center stage in sports conversations as many wonder if Taylor Swift will be in attendance to support her husband, Travis Kelce.

What makes the matchup special

Both teams head into the duel with a perfect 3-0 record, making the match crucial for the AFC West lead. Beyond the historical rivalry stretching back to 1960, the meeting marks the first time the two teams have faced each other while remaining undefeated through the first three rounds.

Taylor Swift's game attendance history

Since marrying Kelce, Swift has attended the first two games of the 2026 season at Arrowhead Stadium, against the Denver Broncos and Indianapolis Colts. She was not spotted at the away game against the Miami Dolphins in Week 3, reinforcing a pattern of higher frequency at home games.

Probability of attendance in Las Vegas

The upcoming clash will take place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, marking an away game for the Chiefs. Sources indicate that the singer tends to avoid games in stadiums she is not intimately familiar with or that have not been previously inspected. Furthermore, she was in New York on Saturday night for a surprise appearance on "Saturday Night Live," which could make her arrival in Las Vegas on time difficult.

How to follow the game

The duel kicks off at 4:25 PM (Brasília time) and will be broadcast live on CBS. For those without a cable TV subscription, the game can be streamed on DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, and Paramount+ platforms, which offer free trial periods for new users.

Fan expectations

Even without official confirmation, Swift's presence has been a focal point of attention, as she has become one of the most talked-about figures alongside the Chiefs. Should she attend, fans hope the energy she displayed at the Arrowhead games will be repeated in Las Vegas, potentially influencing the stadium atmosphere.

With information from Just Jared, Billboard, The Big Lead.
